name: PageHeader
purpose: Introduces a page or major section: title, optional supporting description, and trailing actions in one consistent row.
neverUseFor: Card or panel titles — use Card's own header slot instead
Breadcrumbs or wayfinding — PageHeader is the destination, not the trail
Repeated inside a scrollable list — PageHeader is a page-level element, used once per view

anatomy.description: Layout wrapper — title/description on one side, actions on the other.
The page or section title. Heading level set by the `level` prop.
Supporting one-line description below the title.

props.name: label
props.description: The page or section title text.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting one-line description shown below the title.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level of the title — 1 for a page, 2 for a major in-page section. Never skip a level to change visual size; that's what CSS is for.

props.name: actions
props.description: Trailing content — typically a Button and/or Badge.

a11y.role: banner (implicit only when PageHeader is the page's single top-level heading region — not applied automatically)
